caption: The drawing features two rectangular textile or embroidery patterns centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The upper, smaller rectangle shows a single pink flower with five rounded petals and a purple center, flanked on both sides with sets of two green leaves, all bordered by a brown rectangular frame. The lower, larger square contains a more elaborate symmetrical floral design. In its center, a pink flower with a purple center is positioned, from which three green leafy stems extend outward diagonally, each ending in a similarly designed flower. The flowers at the bottom left and right corners both have pink petals with a dark pink center, while the top stem’s flower matches the central one. Each stem is adorned with pairs of green leaves. This square pattern is also bordered by a brown rectangular frame. Below the central flower motif, a small brown cross shape is visible. The lower right corner of the background contains the name "Syrena Swanson" written in small, light brown cursive text.
title: Burse and Chalice Veil
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
